question: What was the motto of the National Games of India 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Celebrating unity through sports.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 36th__ National Games were organised in Ahmedabad.
 
• The official motto of the games was "__**Celebrating unity through sports**__".
 
• __2022 National Games of India__
 
 
• It was the 36th edition of the National Games of India.
 
• It was held in Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot and Bhavnagar in the state of Gujarat.
 
• The official logo depicts an Asiatic lion head make up of sporting pictograms and the Statue of Unity.
 
• The games mascot was Savaj the asiatic lion.
 
 
 
• The sports programme included athletics, field hockey, football, volleyball, lawn tennis, table tennis, skateboarding, Netball and judo, and also featured traditional sports such as kabaddi, kho kho, mallakhamba, and yogasana.
 
• Services came first with 61 gold, 35 silver and 32 bronze medals for a total of 128.
 
 
• Maharashtra won with 39 gold medals (140 total) and came second.
 
• Haryana won 38 golds (116 total) and came third.
